title: Hushfrost Pass - Lamp in the Canyon
_note: Option A anchor. gbc 4-voice band. emotional preset. Suspended F minor, 68 BPM, max negative space. Vesper motif stretched and fragile: the rising leap (C4->F4->G4) overshoots and hangs too long before a stepwise settle (Ab4->G4->F4). Lone pulse25 bell-call answered by silence; pulse12 slow suspended (sus2/sus4) arp at low gain; tri_bass tonic pedal drone moving only at phrase ends; drums a muffled heartbeat (soft kick on 1, faint pulse on the 'and' of 3). 16 bars, last bar voice-leads back to bar 1 (G2->C... pickup tension to F).
